First, convert 47 weeks and 4 days to days:  
47 weeks = 47 × 7 = 329 days  
Add 4 days → 333 days total to subtract.

Date given: 1164-11-30 (assuming format is MM-DD-YYYY, so November 30, 1164).  
1164 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and not by 100 in Gregorian rules, though Gregorian wasn’t adopted then, but we follow Gregorian arithmetic as instructed).

Subtract 333 days from 1164-11-30:  
Go back 30 days → 1164-10-31  
Remaining 333 − 30 = 303 days to subtract.

From 1164-10-31, subtract another 304 days (since October has 31 days, better to step month by month):  
Actually, easier: subtract full years if possible, but here less than a year.

Let’s do:  
From 1164-11-30 back 333 days:  
1164 is leap year (366 days).  
333 days before Nov 30 is:  
Nov 30 → Oct 31 = 30 days (303 left)  
Oct 31 → Sep 30 = 31 days (272 left)  
Sep 30 → Aug 31 = 30 days (242 left)  
Aug 31 → Jul 31 = 31 days (211 left)  
Jul 31 → Jun 30 = 31 days (180 left)  
Jun 30 → May 31 = 30 days (150 left)  
May 31 → Apr 30 = 31 days (119 left)  
Apr 30 → Mar 31 = 30 days (89 left)  
Mar 31 → Feb 29 (leap) = 31 days (58 left)  
Feb 29 → Jan 31 = 29 days (29 left)  
Jan 31 → Jan 2 = 29 days (0 left).

So date is 1164-01-02.

FINAL_ANSWER: 1164-01-02
